context_for_next_testing_agent: Cost staleness feature fully tested. Key implementation: (1) GET cost-staleness compares OrderItem.internal_cost (snapshot) vs Recipe.cost_per_portion (current), (2) POST refresh-costs only allowed for Draft proposals, updates internal_cost/total_cost/margin fields but preserves unit_price, (3) Recipe cost is derived from ingredient cost_per_unit - to test staleness, update ingredient cost which triggers recipe recalc. Event creation limit (50/month) may affect tests requiring new events.
